title: Consultant(e) en recrutement (contrat)
description:
Notre compagnie:
Basée à Denver, au Colorado, Cologix est une entreprise chef de file en Amérique du Nord dans le domaine de l’interconnexion neutres réseaux et des centres de données edge hyperscale.Notre plateforme offre à nos clients un accès à plus de 45 centres de données numérique edge et hyperscale edge Scalelogix℠ répartis dans 13 marchés aux États-Unis et au Canada, ainsi qu’à un écosystème à forte densité de connectivité comprenant plus de 710 réseaux, plus de 360 fournisseurs de cloud, plus de 35 rampes d’accès (onramps) et sept points d’échange Internet.
Nous offrons à près de 2 000 clients un accès direct à nos équipes opérationnelles locales, favorisant ainsi des partenariats solides appuyés par un soutien opérationnel exceptionnel et un service à la clientèle exemplaire. Soutenue par l’un des plus importants fonds d’infrastructure en Amérique du Nord, l’équipe de direction chevronnée de Cologix, son personnel certifié et son engagement envers les initiatives ESG contribuent à créer une culture qui valorise nos employés, notre environnement et nos clients.
Il s’agit d’un poste entièrement en télétravail.
Au sujet du poste à pourvoir :
Sous la responsabilité du directeur senior chargé du recrutement, le consultant en recrutement (contrat) dirigera les opérations visant à attirer et à sélectionner un ensemble diversifié de talents qualifiés et compétents pour l’organisation chargée de l’exploitation des centres de données. Nous recherchons une personne qui accorde une grande importance à l’expérience des candidats et des responsables du recrutement, et qui est capable d’assimiler rapidement les exigences complexes liées à des postes spécialisés. Il s’agit d’un poste temporaire, sous contrat, destiné à remplacer un collaborateur en congé (4 à 5 mois).
Vos tâches au quotidien :

• Collaborer avec les responsables de service pour identifier et rédiger des descriptions de poste et des critères de recrutement détaillés et précis

• Gérer les processus de publication des offres d’emploi et de promotion des postes

• Organiser les entretiens pour tous les postes et communiquer avec les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement

• Effectuer la présélection des candidats et formuler des recommandations à l’équipe de recrutement concernant les candidats à retenir pour la suite du processus

• Participe et anime le processus d’entretien, en assistant et en tenant des séances de retour d’expérience avec les responsables, les directeurs et les autres parties prenantes

• Collabore avec le responsable du recrutement et/ou d’autres membres du service des ressources humaines tout au long du processus d’offre d’emploi, en identifiant et en recommandant les fourchettes salariales, les primes, les dates de prise de fonction et tout autre détail pertinent

• Veille au respect des lois et réglementations fédérales, régionales, provinciales et locales en matière d’emploi, ainsi que des politiques de l’entreprise

• Gère les bases de données de recrutement et le système ATS (Lever) afin de garantir l’exactitude des rapports de recrutement

• Effectue toute autre tâche qui lui est confiée

Ce qui fait de vous un bon candidat : (Qualifications)

• Licence en ressources humaines ou dans un domaine similaire, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente, requise

• Une expérience préalable en recrutement dans le secteur des télécommunications ou des centres de données est un atout

• Une expérience en recrutement dans un environnement à fort volume pour des postes axés sur les opérations, notamment dans les domaines du CVC, de la mécanique, de la maintenance technique, etc., est un atout

• Bonnes compétences en matière de création de relations et expérience avérée de collaboration avec différents types de responsables du recrutement

• Une expérience préalable au sein d’une agence de recrutement est un atout

• Une expérience et une capacité avérée à rechercher des candidats de manière passive (LinkedIn Recruiter) constituent un atout

title: Support Engineer
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

- We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

- We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

- We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location:

- Remote - United Arab Emirates

About the role:

We’re looking for an experienced Support Engineer to join our team and own the technical and functional customer support experience end-to-end. This role sits at the intersection of technical support, engineering, and customer success. You’ll become a product expert, working closely with customers, third-party providers, and internal engineering teams to troubleshoot, resolve, and prevent issues across Sardine’s API-driven platform.

You’ll operate independently with global teammates and will play a critical role in maintaining service quality across time zones. The ideal candidate is technical, self-sufficient, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

What you’ll be doing:

- Be the first point of contact of customers and quickly and efficiently understand their needs and requests via various channels (email, chat, phone).

- Own, prioritize, and troubleshoot the complex technical issues and provide an excellent solution to the customers

- Be a key source of knowledge on the sardine risk and payment platform, APIs, SDKs, the underlying web-stack technologies, and best practices

- Be innovative and forward-thinking with time to create valuable tools and documentation that will help our team and clients be more successful and self-sufficient

- Provide high-quality technical support to customers via various channels

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly and effectively

- Collaborate with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions

- Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of Sardine to effectively troubleshoot and resolve customer issues.

- Stay updated on product enhancements, new features, and industry best practices.

- Analyze and diagnose technical issues reported by customers and provide timely resolutions.

- Escalate issues to the development team when necessary, providing detailed information for efficient problem resolution.

- Document troubleshooting steps and solutions for internal and external knowledge bases.

- Advocate for customer needs and collaborate with internal teams to address and prioritize product bugs and product improvements.

- Contribute to the development of documentation, tools and processes to streamline support.

What You’ll Need:

- 5+ years in a technical support, support engineering, solutions engineering, or software engineering role

- Fluent in English

- Strong understanding of web technologies, APIs, and cloud infrastructure

- Proficiency with SQL (joins, queries across multiple tables)

title: Software Engineer - Low Speed Motion Planning & Control
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for bright engineers interested in designing elegant solutions to difficult problems in the autonomy space.  Your contributions will focus on building out capabilities of an autonomous vehicle stack, including necessary enablement work on the infrastructure- and vehicle-side. At Applied Intuition, we encourage engineers to take ownership over technical and product decisions, interact closely with users & customers to collect feedback, and contribute to a thoughtful, dynamic team culture.

In addition to your engineering contributions, by working in our dynamic and customer-focused team culture, you will contribute to and learn from best practices in the nascent autonomy industry. We move fast and we focus on excellence, for our products and for our business. If you are hands-on and looking for a place to have a multiplying effect on making autonomous systems a reality, Applied is the place for you! 

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Design and implement motion planning and controls modules that can be deployed on various vehicle platforms, enabling them for highly accurate autonomous navigation in tight scenarios.

- Characterize the dynamics of our customers’ vehicles to create tailored controls solutions and to reduce the gap between simulation and real-world dynamics.

- Evaluate and utilize academic research to create optimal-control-based solutions using techniques like nonlinear MPC and MPPI control.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- Passion about tackling challenging motion planning or motion control problems 

- Bachelors, MSc or PhD in mechanical engineering or computer science with coursework or research experience in motion planning or controls.

- 3+ years of experience building production software using modern software practices.

- Hands-on experience testing controls solutions on real, production-grade vehicles.

- Fluency in control theory, numerical optimization, numerical analysis, and physics.

- Enthusiasm for coming up with practical solutions to cutting-edge challenges in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience writing high-performance C++ code.

NICE TO HAVE:

- Experience writing software that is compliant with guidelines for safety-critical C++ code, such as MISRA and AUTOSAR.

- Experience using quadratic programming solvers or nonlinear optimization tools. 

- Experience applying machine learning techniques to vehicle dynamics modeling.

- Experience working both with large industrial /commercial vehicles, as well as passenger cars.

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity

We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

Our work spans post-training open-weight models for specialized capabilities and pioneering new approaches to voice AI, turning research breakthroughs into reliable production systems.

- Turn ambiguous product and customer problems into well-framed machine learning problems.

- Advance our post-training work, from supervised fine-tuning toward reinforcement learning and long-horizon optimization.

- Work with large-scale, proprietary datasets spanning text and audio interactions.

- The ability to operate with high agency and work across the stack when needed to deliver an outcome.

- Alignment with Sierra’s values, including Craftsmanship, Customer Obsession, and Competitive Intensity.

- A degree in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

EVEN BETTER…

- Experience in search, ranking, recommendations, or advertising systems.

- Experience training and deploying language, speech, or multimodal models.

- Experience designing model evaluations tied to real-world product outcomes.

title: Safety Analysis Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Safety Analysis Engineer to join our team. 

Position Description:

We are seeking a skilled Safety Analysis Engineer to support the development of the safety basis for a first-of-a-kind used nuclear fuel recycling facility. You will support the identification and evaluation of hazards/accidents, the designation of Items Relied On For Safety (IROFS), and the development of management measures. Additionally, you will support radiological, subcriticality, chemical, and fire safety programs.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Develop and maintain safety basis documents according to applicable Nuclear Regulatory Commission regulation and guidance

• Support Integrated Safety Analysis (ISA), Criticality Safety Evaluations, Fire Hazard Analysis (FHA), and Natural Phenomena Hazard (NPH) analysis

• Identify and evaluate radiological, criticality, chemical, fire, and natural phenomena hazards

• Identify and evaluate accident sequences using both inductive and deductive methods

• Perform deterministic consequence severity calculations for radiological/chemical source term and dose

• Perform likelihood calculations using qualitative and semi-quantitative (e.g., layers of protection analysis)

• Designate items relied on for safety (IROFS) for the prevention and mitigation of accidents

• Develop management measures to ensure adequate availability and reliability of IROFS

Competencies:

We are looking for a Safety Analysis Engineer that is:

• Passionate about clean energy

• An optimist at heart

• Passionate about making advanced fission a reality

• Willing and able to learn quickly

• Willing to think differently and do things in new ways

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before

• Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems

• An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

• Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, nuclear engineering, or related discipline; a master's or Ph.D. is highly desirable

• 3-5 years of experience in experience in nuclear safety, process safety, or similar high-hazard environments.

• Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP) and Failure Modes and Effects (FMEA) PHA methods

Bonus Qualifications:

• NRC licensed fuel cycle facility safety basis development

• Consequence severity analysis using RADTRAD, MELCOR/MACCS, ARCON and PAVAN

• Event tree and fault tree analysis

• NUREG-1513, NUREG-1520, NUREG-1718 and relevant regulatory frameworks

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process.  You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team.  If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us!  There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated.  You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance!  It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others.  We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that

title: GTM Strategy & Operations
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling is looking for a GTM Strategy & Operations lead to drive high-impact global initiatives, while providing in-region operational and analytical leadership and support for EMEA. Reporting to the Head of RevOps and partnering directly with sales leadership, you'll own the operating cadence that keeps the business running - from annual planning and capacity modeling to forecasting, pipeline health, and quarterly business reviews. You'll also shape how AI gets applied across the GTM org, identifying high-impact use cases and driving adoption. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll work closely with Marketing, Strategic Finance, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, and Business Intelligence to turn data into decisions. - Help drive the analytical rhythm of the business by owning performance reporting and analyzing data to generate meaningful insights and recommendations

- Proactively drive operational efficiency and team productivity by continuously improving processes, tools, and reporting

- Shape the GTM AI roadmap, from defining high-impact use cases, building or buying the right solutions, and ensuring successful adoption of new capabilities

- Partner with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Strategic Finance, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, Technology & Systems, Business Intelligence, etc.

- Drive various high priority cross-functional initiatives from ideation and planning, through execution

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, or related analytical/GTM roles,

- A builder mentality, with a track record of repeatable and scalable systems and processes.

- A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and brings structured thinking to solve

title: Paid Social Supervisor
description:
About Walker Advertising

Since 1984, Walker Advertising has bridged the gap between a law firm's need to grow and an underserved community's need for trustworthy legal services. Our teams lead with empathy and without ego to serve others through integrity and trust. We dare to think differently and work to consistently raise the bar, creating a workplace environment based on respect.

We believe that our employees are not just numbers; they are people. People with families and lives outside of work. We understand that a career is just one piece of the puzzle that makes people successful, happy individuals. That's why as we grow our teams, we focus on the whole person.

About the role

You will own Meta and TikTok end to end - strategy, budget, and day-to-day execution - for a portfolio of legal lead generation brands serving English- and Spanish-speaking consumers across the United States.

This is a hands-on-keys role. You will be in Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager yourself, building campaigns, writing and briefing creative, reading results, and making the call on where the next dollar goes. There is no media buyer underneath you executing your plan.

A note on measurement. Our leads are not purchases - a form fill starts a process that either ends in a represented case or does not. You will work with offline conversion imports, the Conversions API, and in-platform data, and you will be measured on lead quality as much as on lead cost.

This is a regulated category. Attorney advertising is governed by state bar rules, and platform policy limits what ad copy may imply about the person seeing it. You will work closely with our legal team to keep campaigns compliant.

How this role actually runs - nobody is going to hand you a playbook for these channels and ask you to execute it. Priorities move, and you will regularly be the person who has to decide what happens next and then defend the call. We want someone who treats the budget like their own money, who would rather get a test live than wait for a perfect brief, and who comes back with an answer rather than a blocker. You will have real latitude here. The trade is that you have to use it.

What you'll own

•
Channel strategy and budget. Set the plan for Meta and TikTok across our brands - which audiences, which practice areas, which markets, which languages. Own the budget: allocate it, pace it, defend the allocation with numbers, and move it when the numbers say to. Budget is determined by performance which is function of geo and the dynamics of that market, not just at the account level.

•
Execution. Build and manage campaigns yourself. Account structure, audience strategy, bidding, placements, exclusions, budget pacing, and daily optimization. You are the person in the account.

•
Creative direction and testing. A combination of in-house teams and outsources creative partners write and produce the creative, and they bring their own concepts to the table. You are not project managing that pipeline or generating every idea in it. What you own is the platform side of the conversation: briefing what you need, telling the team what the data says is working or fatiguing, and shaping the test plan with them.

•
Landing page and conversion optimization. Work with our CRO team the same way you work with creative. Bring what the traffic data tells you, help prioritize what gets tested on the pages your campaigns point to, and coordinate the calendar so page tests and creative tests are not confounding each other on the same campaign at the same time.

•
Measurement and signal quality. Work with our analytics and development partners to make sure the platforms are receiving clean downstream signal - Conversions API, offline conversion imports, value-based signals where they apply. Build reporting that ties spend to retained cases, not to form fills.

•
QA and reporting. Run routine QA across everything your campaigns touch - in-platform setup, tracking, and the landing pages yo

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

•

Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

Bei FlixTrain hat Sicherheit im Eisenbahnbetrieb oberste Priorität. Als Betriebskontrolleur (m/w/d) stellst du die Überwachung der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden gemäß den Vorgaben der FlixTrain sicher, führst Prüfungen durch und sorgst dafür, dass Regelwerke konsequent umgesetzt werden - im Alltag wie in Ausnahmesituationen. Du agierst mit hoher Fachkompetenz, Fingerspitzengefühl und klarer Haltung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Betrieb, Mitarbeitenden und Behörden.

Über die Rolle

• Du führst Betriebskontrollen und Überwachungsfahrten durch und wertest Fahrdaten gemäß den Sicherheitszielen aus

• Das Qualifikationsmanagement inklusive Führung der „Betrieblichen Akte“ der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden liegt in deiner Hand

• Mitfahrberechtigungen sowie Strecken- und Ortskenntnis-Erwerbsaufträge gibst du aus und verwaltest die zugehörigen Zusatzbescheinigungen

• Per Stichprobe kontrollierst du Dienstpläne und Schichten hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Lenk- und Ruhezeiten sowie der Planungsvorgaben gemäß BRW

• Bei Unfall- und Ereignisuntersuchungen wirkst du mit, übernimmst den EVU-Notdienst und agierst als Prüfer:in gemäß Prüfungsordnung der FlixTrain GmbH

• An der Weiterentwicklung des Sicherheitsmanagementsystems und des Regelwerks arbeitest du aktiv mit und pflegst die Safety-internen digitalen Anwendungen

• Im Rahmen der ECM-Aufgaben überprüfst du die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und ECM-interner Vorgaben für den betriebssicheren Einsatz der Fahrzeuge

Über Dich

• Du bringst einen Triebfahrzeugführerschein mit gültiger Zusatzbescheinigung sowie mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung (ohne Anrechnung der Ausbildungszeit) mit

• Das eisenbahnbetriebliche Regelwerk beherrschst du sehr sicher, idealerweise inklusive europäischer Regelungen und des grenznahen Auslands

• Eine Tauglichkeit gemäß TfV und mindestens ein Realschulabschluss sind bei dir gegeben, sowie nachweisbare Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1-Niveau

• Mit mindestens 100 Fahrstunden als Triebfahrzeugführer:in im Kalenderjahr und einem PKW-Führerschein bist du bestens aufgestellt

• Deutschlandweit bist du gerne unterwegs und zeigst Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und nachts sowie zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften

• Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren

• Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze - auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

• Mobilität:   Mit deiner BahnCard100   bist du jederzeit flexibel unterwegs - auch in deiner Freizeit.   

• Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.

• Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.

• Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.

• Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.

• Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Windchill Interface Specialist
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are seeking an experienced Windchill Interface Specialist to design, build, and operate integrations connecting PTC Windchill with ERP, MES, CAD, and other engineering and manufacturing systems. In this role you will own the technical integration layer between Windchill and the broader enterprise systems landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on Windchill integration experience and a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware platforms, and PLM-to-ERP data flows. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

• Experience designing PLM-to-ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle).

• Working knowledge of CAD integration patterns.

• Experience with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, or SAP CPI.

• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Windchill data model.

• Experience with REST and SOAP web services.

• Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• PTC Windchill certifications.

• Experience with ThingWorx or IIoT integration.

• Exposure to API management platforms.

• Familiarity with event-driven and Kafka-based integration patterns.

• Experience operating Windchill in the cloud.

Job Overview
The Lead Recruiter partners with the Recruiting Manager to lead a team of 7-9 recruiters who build and sustain a nationwide network of legal process servers, including experienced, active process servers and gig-oriented candidates interested in entering the field. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will carry your own recruiting workload while coaching teammates, helping set the pace, and keeping pipelines healthy across the US. Team Leadership (in partnership with the Recruiting Manager)

• Help lead, coach, and develop a team of 7-9 recruiters

Recruiting & Sourcing

• Carry a recruiting workload, including high-volume outreach (cold calling, SMS, email campaigns)

• Proficient in Excel, including data tools and formulas, with comfort building reports

Full-Time position Monday-Friday

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93 , the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

Position Overview

The Director of Payor Relations is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning all payor relations and payor strategy activity across an assigned regional market portfolio within Metro Vein Centers’ multi-state, multi-TIN network. This individual is the single point of accountability for every payor relationship, contract, negotiation, and strategic initiative within their region-operating with a high degree of autonomy while staying aligned with enterprise objectives.

The Director owns the full lifecycle of payor contract management within their region: market research, building relationships with payors, interpreting contract terms, maintaining fee schedules, driving renegotiations, resolving payor issues, and translating complex reimbursement requirements into clear operational guidance for Revenue Cycle, Finance, Credentialing, and Operations. title: Accelerated Computing Research Intern
description:
NVIDIA is searching for a MSc/PhD candidate to join our growing software architecture team. The ideal candidate will be conducting innovative research at the intersection of Networking, Security, and Communications, and working alongside top authorities in these fields. With incredible resources at your disposal, you will be able to impact, contribute and advance these exiting domains. Topics include but are not limited to remote direct memory access, hardware offloading and acceleration, AI for networking and security, storage management, cryptography, and architecture. With its unique open culture, NVIDIA is one of the best industry labs to do Accelerated
Computing research.

DPU Data-Processing Units are the smallest form of a data center, and provide the foundation to implement accelerated computing, where both processing and networking experience a performance boost through the utilization of dedicated processors. DPUs started out as the engine for accelerated networking, but now they can run AI inference and training on-board, deep packet inspection and cryptography accelerations among others thanks to onboard GPUs and acceleration engines. Join us to research next-generation accelerated data-center architectures in a unique internship with NVIDIA partnership.

What you’ll be doing :

• Be at the forefront of modern data center research

• Partner and collaborate with forward-thinking industry leaders and external researchers

• Participate and speak at conferences and events

• Publish original research

• Work with intelligent networking machines powered by AI systems that can learn, reason and interact with other network components

What we need to see:

• Pursuing a PhD or a MSc Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or Computer Engineering

• General computer science background, preferably in algorithm design, system programming, networking, operating system, and computer architecture.

• Strong programming (C/C++/Python) and software development skills

• Low-level Linux

• Good communications skills

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love the challenge of crafting the highest performance & lowest power silicon possible? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our Networking Research Team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field.

Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Health, dental and vision insurance

• Paid time off

• Annual CEU allowance

• 401K

• Supplies and other perks

• Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

About Logos
Logos is a movement to rebuild civil society using decentralised technologies. Logos is a sovereign, decentralised technology stack that allows for the creation of new types of corruption-resistant social institutions. It is designed to champion personal liberties and collective abundance through upgrading human governance.
As an open source movement, we need coders, creatives, and anyone passionate to help us build, own, and govern it.
Circles initiative
Logos Circles are self-organised groups that take action to solve issues that matter locally. They are a form of parallel governance: instead of reforming broken or rigged institutions, they build better ones that live on or are sustained by the network. Circles respond to local needs, build trust on the ground through solving problems, and experiment with real-world applications of Logos tech and values.

Your Impact at LILA

Join our physical sciences team to contribute to developing ML- and agent-driven infrastructure that enables Lila's scientific superintelligence to autonomously construct, execute, and interpret complex physics simulations and apply these to real-world scientific problems in materials science and chemistry. You will work on projects involving one of these areas: enabling AI agents to reason over and orchestrate simulations, developing ML methods to accelerate atomistic simulations, and leveraging agentic simulations for applications in materials discovery.

What You'll Be Building

• Contribute to projects involving one of these areas: AI agents for simulations, ML models for atomistic simulations, and in silico materials discovery.

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

title: VP, Business Development and Earned Revenue
description:
Code for America believes government can work for the people, by the people, in the new digital age, and that government at all levels can and should work well for all people. For more than a decade, we’ve worked to show that with the mindful use of technology, we can break down barriers, meet community needs, and find real solutions.
Our employees build and transform government and community tools and services, making them so good they inspire change. We merge the best parts of technology, nonprofit, and government to help support the people who need it most.
With a focus on transparency and fairness, and deep empathy for partners in government and community organizations and the people that our partners serve, we’re building a movement of motivated change agents driven by meaningful results and lasting impact.
At Code for America , you contribute to exciting work while learning and developing in a supportive and flexible environment. Our compensation and benefits are holistic and thoughtfully curated to represent our employees and our mission. Help us drive real generational change that lasts.
Code for America is looking for a talented VP of Business Development and Earned Revenue who will establish evidence-backed earned-revenue models that advance Code for America 's mission and contribute to its long-term financial sustainability. Impact will include paying customers, viable delivery economics, disciplined investment decisions, and a practical path to growing the strongest offerings.
About the role:
The VP of Business Development and Earned Revenue will build and prove Code for America ’s earned-revenue strategy, from identifying promising business models to testing them with paying customers and growing what works. Code for America is a nonprofit with an approximately $40 million annual budget, funded primarily through philanthropy. This leader will identify which mission-aligned offerings, buyers, and business models can strengthen that funding base, test them with paying customers, and guide decisions about where to invest and grow.
This is a hands-on executive role for someone who has built a new line of business from an uncertain starting point. Working with the CEO and across Product, Programs, Engineering, and Finance, the VP will translate ideas into focused commercial experiments, personally secure early paid engagements, and turn the strongest opportunities into repeatable offerings. Those offerings may include products, standardized services, implementation support, or a combination. As a member of the executive leadership team, the VP owns Code for America ’s earned-revenue strategy, makes portfolio decisions within an agreed investment threshold, and brings larger investment decisions to the CEO and Board. The VP leads in a matrixed environment, partnering with Delivery and Enablement teams.
The Strategic Partnerships team will continue to own ongoing government partnership development within Code for America 's existing strategy. The VP will collaborate with that team when testing paid government offerings. Ownership of government buyer relationships, commercial testing, and customer commitments will be defined in a shared agreement with Strategic Partnerships leadership before outreach begins.
Specific revenue and learning targets will be agreed with the CEO. Success in the first year will include:

• A prioritized earned-revenue strategy grounded in customer discovery, mission value, and business cases with explicit assumptions.

• A small number of paid tests that generate revenue and credible evidence about buyer demand, pricing, procurement, and delivery economics.

• Clear recommendations - made in close partnership with the CEO - about which models deserve further investment, which need refinement, and which should stop, with a practical growth and staffing plan for the strongest opportunities.

This role will report to the CEO and is expected to travel no more than 25 % of the time.
